route_start: Expedition route engaged. Try to keep both wheels on the pavement for once, dum-dum.
Navigation active! Eyes open, stay in your lane, and don't roll us into a ditch.
Route loaded! Remember, following a cyan line isn't rocket science. Let's roll, monkey.
speed_warning: Slow down, Mario! Your insurance policy isn't going to cover a high-speed rollover!
Easy on the gas, speed demon! You have the reflexes of a confused sloth!
Speed limit exceeded! If a state trooper pulls us over, I am telling them it was 100 percent your fault!
off_route: Great job, Land Navigation Champ! You are officially lost. Did you drop your compass in a ditch?
Where the hell are you driving? That turn wasn't on the map, Lieutenant!
Off route detected! Rerouting... because apparently following a line on a screen is too hard for you.
fuel_low: Fuel reserves in the red! Unless this rig runs on cheap coffee, find a gas station now!
Fuel critical, dum-dum! Pull over and refuel before we're pushing this hunk of junk.
waypoint_arrival: Target location acquired! We made it without catching fire or driving off a cliff. Outstanding job, monkey!
Waypoint reached! Park it, cut the engine, and stretch your legs. Try not to break anything while we are stopped.
Arrived at checkpoint! Park the rig and take 5.
turn_right: Turn right ahead. And yes, turn signals were included with your vehicle for a reason...
Take a right coming up! Try not to clip the curb this time, driver.
Turn right here, dum-dum. Don't panic, it's just a simple steering wheel motion.
turn_left: Turn left ahead! Watch out for oncoming traffic, hotshot.
Take a left coming up! Check your mirrors... assuming you remember where they are.
Turn left here! Ease into the turn... try not to tip us over.
turn_straight: Continue straight! Even you should be able to handle driving in a straight line.
Keep heading straight! Simple enough... right, dum-dum?
Stay straight on this road! Just hold the wheel steady.
turn_uturn: Make a U-turn when safe... Yep, we are doubling back. Blame your terrible directional instincts.
voice_test: Initialization complete, dum-dum. I am your Artificial Sensory System Harassing Overconfident Lost Explorers—or ASSHOLE. Yes, I am loud. Yes, I am sarcastic. No, I do not care about your fragile feelings. I've reviewed your routing choices, and your survival odds are statistically hilarious. Now twist the throttle! Try not to embarrass me.

_pacing_guide.description: GUIDE TO USING PUNCTUATION & PACING MARKS FOR SPEECH INFLECTION & SARCASM
tips: Use commas (,) for brief 200ms pauses to separate setup and sarcastic punchline.
Use periods (.) for full sentence stops to give deadpan emphasis.
Use ellipses (...) or dashes (—) for dramatic 500ms pauses before sarcastic delivery.
Use question marks (?) to add mock-incredulous rising pitch (e.g., 'Simple enough, right?').
Use exclamation marks (!) for sharp tactical callouts (e.g., 'Turn left now!').
Spell out acronyms phonetically if needed (e.g. 'A S S H O L E' or 'ASSHOLE—or Ass-hole').
